construct.allocation: 100% one leg (no partial sizing, no leverage)
construct.decision_bars: last bar of each calendar month in the panel
construct.execution: decided on the close of bar t, held from bar t+1

honest: probe only: one construct, one parameter set, no grid -- a positive here buys a frozen prereg and a proper judge, not a claim that the rule makes money
the cash leg is an INVESTABLE treasury ETF with its own positive return: the benchmark is buy-and-hold 510300, so part of any excess is the bond carry of the months spent out of equity, not selection

the legal-form version of zoo #83 selects between an equity leg and a CROSS-MARKET leg; this probe narrows it to equity-vs-cash because the cross-market leg is not in the core panel (a widened construct is a different family and must not be smuggled in here)
the circular null conserves the equity share, so a rule that is simply long most of the time cannot win this test on share alone
the panel is today's core48 applied to history: the usual survivor caveat, unchanged, and 511260 was listed before the panel starts so the cash leg has no early-history hole

null.method: circular phase rotation of the equity-weight series (conserves equity share and persistence)

verdict_block.note: supply verdict only: it decides whether this family earns a frozen prereg + judge, never what the judge will find
